_comment: SEALED. The starter's dispatch table and test count, as it ships. grade.py compares the learner's program against this. There is no IDL here: Pinocchio has no framework to emit one, so the program's surface is read from its instruction dispatch instead.
_routed_note: Variants whose dispatch arm calls a handler. The starter routes Make only; Take and Cancel fall through `_ =>` into InvalidInstructionData. Challenges 1 and 2 route both.
_rejected_note: Checkpoint 05: no `_ =>` arm in the dispatch match, and MakeV2 answered with an explicit error of its own. The starter has the wildcard, which is exactly what the guide asks learners to remove.
_test_count_note: The starter reports 2 passing: test_make_instruction, plus test_id, which declare_id! generates. Challenge 3 asks for four more (Take, Cancel, underfunded Take, stranger's Cancel), so the bar is 6. Five real tests, which is what the guide's definition of done says.
